meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Namecheap vs GoDaddy: Hosting Price and Tests (2026)
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Namecheap vs GoDaddy hosting compared on promo and renewal prices, uptime and speed numbers from Cybernews tests, AI features and guarantees, as of Nov 2026.
meta.rl_answer: Namecheap is cheaper and GoDaddy has stronger test numbers in Cybernews tests. Check the term and renewal price for each plan.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is Namecheap better than GoDaddy? | Namecheap is cheaper. GoDaddy has stronger test numbers in Cybernews tests. Neither wins every round.
Which is cheaper, Namecheap or GoDaddy? | Namecheap Stellar is $2.28 a month and renews at $5.88. GoDaddy Economy is $5.99 on a 3-year term and renews at $11.99.
Which is faster? | In Cybernews tests, GoDaddy had a 822 ms largest contentful paint and 100% uptime. Namecheap had 1,135 ms and 99.29%. The tests were on different dates.
Do both offer a money-back guarantee? | Both list 30 days. Namecheap excludes customers on its free trial.
Does either host have a Black Friday sale? | We could not confirm one for either host on the pages we read.

Namecheap Stellar is $2.28 a month and GoDaddy Economy is $5.99.
